additionalDescription: Legal language has historically been a barrier that keeps everyday people from understanding their rights. Charter was built to break down that barrier. Every feature was designed with non-lawyers in mind, translating complex legal jargon into plain English while maintaining legal accuracy.
highlights: Built an AI-powered contract analysis engine using NLP
Created a library of 100+ customizable legal templates
Implemented clause-by-clause explanations in plain English
Designed a collaborative review workflow for teams
